line: SESSION SUMMARY — rotation run 1 (reasonable persona), 27 turns answered across 4 worlds sharing the mailbox: Copper's Marsh (primary), Old Tide, Fraying Bell of Vael, + the 5 Saltmarsh test fixtures. Turns arrived heavily OUT OF ORDER; each answered from its own digest, canonical openers given full establishing treatment when they surfaced.

MAIN ARC (Copper's Marsh / Manfred Carrow, Ranger): a clean slow-drip mystery built organically — spotted Costtore burying Color-Miners contraband (Stealth branch, near-miss), dug it up (impossible shifting pigment), leveraged it into a shed negotiation that leaked the faction's debt-labor + people-are-being-Changed horror, seeded the internal front (town of replacements) WITHOUT dumping its doom, made Costtore a recurring ally, and got a quest-lead to the up-marsh outpost (wilderness frontier). PC reached 4 XP.

CONTRACT DISCIPLINE held: narrated FROM player rolls never re-rolled; used rollRequest+branches for routine checks (Stealth x2), bare veiled reads for secret-DC Insight (§6.1); margin ladder honored (Stealth 7 = straight fail → combat; 11 = near-miss); verbatim player dialogue quoted exactly (§3); open handoffs, zero option-menus, zero coached tactics; fact_canonized reserved for genuine reveals (§8.3a); one adjudication logged an alliance; gen npc used for consequential sources (Beabella, Wymar Sallow) per the tiering gate.

COMBAT: the Saltmarsh fixture chain ran the full lifecycle — Stealth-fail opened combat_start with 3 CR-1/8 marsh-cloak foes in a stilt-hut zone, PC disadvantaged; handed off open for the player's first action (fight ended by external stop before rounds ran).

LOOP HEALTH: two-call protocol clean throughout; burn gate checked at turns 5/10/14/18/24 — sustained <30k/turn (digests python-sliced not raw-read, no agent spawns), never tripped. ONE standing flag: prepPending unserviced every Copper's Marsh turn — no Workflow tool in a plain Claude Code session (SD-006); un-reskinned walks are the designed fallback and held fine. Ended on dev/.playtest-stop (empty/external) after 27 turns.
